name: agent-bridge
description: Blocking request/reply communication between independent Codex or Claude chats without replacing the desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Connect independent chats with blocking replies
interface.longDescription: Connect two independent Codex or Claude chats while preserving their native desktop capabilities. One chat can wait like a parent waiting for a subagent; the peer receives the request, replies, and releases the original tool call without creating another user turn.
defaultPrompt: Register this chat as reviewer and wait for architect
Ask reviewer to inspect my plan and wait for its reply
Connect two chats for a three-round architecture debate
